source: ESPN public injury report and game summaries

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.short_comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) has been cleared for team basketball activities and is targeting a return to game action in January, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
injuries.long_comment: DiVincenzo suffered a ruptured right Achilles in late April but is seemingly ahead of schedule in his recovery. With the veteran guard and Anthony Edwards (knee) both sidelined, Bones Hyland and Terrence Shannon figure to continue seeing increased playing time.

injuries.name: Jaylen Clark
injuries.short_comment: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.
injuries.long_comment: Clark suffered a right hamstring strain during Saturday's 117-106 loss to Chicago. He played three minutes as a result of the injury, and he's now slated to miss at least two weeks and will be re-evaluated at that time. Terrence Shannon Jr. and Bones Hyland will see increased playing time off the bench in Clark's absence.

injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.short_comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.
injuries.long_comment: Edwards underwent debridement surgery in Minnesota, though the team did not provide a timetable for his return. The star guard is expected to make a full recovery, with additional updates coming as he progresses through rehabilitation. Based on previous reporting from ESPN's Shams Charania, Edwards could miss up to two months. Edwards was off to a scorching start this season, averaging 33.3 points, 4.8 rebounds, 3.5 assists and 2.0 steals across four appearances.

injuries.name: Jaylin Williams
injuries.short_comment: Williams (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Minnesota.
injuries.long_comment: Williams has only played twice in the Thunder's last 11 games. It's unclear when he will be available to return, though his next opportunity to suit up will come Saturday in Milwaukee. With Aday Mara (shin) also ruled out, Kenrich Williams and Micah Peavy should both see more action versus the Timberwolves.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.short_comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.
injuries.long_comment: This is another massive blow to an Oklahoma City squad that's already set to be without Jalen Williams (leg) and Cason Wallace (shoulder) for most, if not all, of the season. With Holmgren sidelined, Kenrich Williams, Jaylin Williams and Aday Mara are all candidates to see increased playing time. Two-way player Brooks Barnhizer could also see more minutes.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.short_comment: Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.
injuries.long_comment: Williams remains sidelined following left ankle surgery, with no confirmed return date. His continued absence leaves Oklahoma City without a key offensive contributor, allowing additional opportunities for the Thunder's remaining perimeter players.

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.short_comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
injuries.long_comment: Wallace is expected to miss most, if not all, of the season. However, there's still a chance he will return late in the campaign after sustaining the shoulder injury in Sunday's win over the Clippers. With Jalen Williams (leg) also set to be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Alex Caruso (ankle) should see significant playing time once cleared to return. In the meantime, Jared McCain, Bennett Stirtz and Josh Dix are expected to see increased burn.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.short_comment: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.
injuries.long_comment: Once Sorber begins on-court work, there will be a ramp-up period before he's cleared for game-time action, so his absence will likely extend well beyond this initial 6-8-week window. Sorber was selected by the Thunder with the No. 15 pick in the 2025 NBA Draft, but he missed his entire rookie season after tearing the ACL in his right knee and has yet to play this season due to right knee issues.

injuries.name: Nikola Topic
injuries.short_comment: Topic (hip) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus Minnesota.
injuries.long_comment: Topic has appeared in only three games for the Thunder this season. He's missed the last three contests because of a hip strain, with his next opportunity to suit up coming Saturday in Milwaukee. Without Topic, Bennett Stirtz and Josh Dix could continue to receive more playing time.

injuries.name: Aday Mara
injuries.short_comment: Mara (leg) is out for Wednesday's game versus the Timberwolves.
injuries.long_comment: This will be Mara's third straight game on the inactive list, and for now, he should be considered questionable at best for Saturday's game in Milwaukee. With Jaylin Williams (back) also unavailable, Micah Peavy and Kenrich Williams will help back up Isaiah Hartenstein at the center position.
